name: Jane H. Davis
bioAdditions: FamilySearch: Jane Hamilton Davis, daughter of William Chapman Davis and Mary Virginia Armstrong, born Pleasant Hill, Louisiana, 1902; married Leo G. Heffernan in 1922; in the 1940 census as Jane Heffernan; died El Paso 1975 as Jane Davis McMaster (Texas death record) and buried at Arlington (S1).
